title: Nice, but please add these
body:
So Finch is a really nice app I really really really like it. It’s the best actually! You can design your own pet, name it,and even play with it,or send it on adventures! Even meeting new friends!
But here are some things I prefer to be changed:
1-I would like to make my own response and then my pet answers toward it not just saying oh it’s nice
2-more variety of clothes…
3- telling your pet what is happening in your day
When you feel that you need an advice you can ask your pet
4-more variety of good vibes to friends
Finch is awesome it just needs some few touches

title: AMAZING APP+ add on note!
body:
I’ve been using this app for about two years now and it’s been the best! It’s been doing it’s job! And I love my pet! It’s been the best time with her, especially as I saw the app change and become better. 

As for the add on, one problem I have with the app is on busy days I can’t really enter the app, I’d be busy all day and forget to log in, I know people usually log in the morning and do check ins, but sometimes there is no time. 

So then the next day rolls around and I didn’t log in yesterday so I can’t write the goals I completed, many times I’ve done all the goals but couldn’t put them as complete which ruins my streak. 

Can you put it so you can log the previous days goals even if I didn’t log in that day?
